jobs.description:
Questrade Financial Group (QFG), through its companies \- Questrade, Questbank, Questrade Wealth Management, Community Trust Company, Zolo, and Flexiti, provides securities and foreign currency investment, professionally managed investment portfolios, mortgages, real estate services, financial services and more. We use cutting\-edge technology to help Canadians become much more financially successful and secure.
  
At QFG, we combine human\-centric collaboration with AI\-driven innovation to redefine financial services. The ideal candidate will be a catalyst for change, using AI to transform and deliver unparalleled customer experiences and shaping a future where AI empowers our teams to do their best work.
  
Join our diverse, inclusive, and hybrid workplace to unleash your creativity and nurture your curiosity without limits. If you share this sense of infinite possibility, come shape your future at QFG.
  
  

What’s in it for you as an employee of QFG?
  
* Health \& wellbeing resources and programs
* Paid vacation, personal, and sick days for work\-life balance
* Competitive compensation and benefits packages
* Work\-life balance in a hybrid environment with at least 3 days in office
* Career growth and development opportunities
* Opportunities to contribute to community causes
* Work with diverse team members in an inclusive and collaborative environment


This job posting is for an existing vacancy.
  
  

We’re looking for our next Junior Risk \& Credit Analyst. Could It Be You?
  
Safeguard Questrade’s capital and operational integrity by executing critical risk and credit functions across regular and extended trading hours.
  
The Junior Risk \& Credit Analyst actively monitors real\-time trading activity and market conditions to mitigate financial and operational exposure. In this role, the analyst ensures client positions align with established risk parameters, addresses account variances, and proactively intervenes to prevent excessive leverage or speculative overexposure. By enforcing margin compliance and maintaining accurate equity balances, the analyst protects both client accounts and the firm from capital losses and negative equity scenarios.
  
  

Need more details? Keep reading…
  
**In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:**
  
* Monitor Portfolio Concentration: Continuously analyze portfolio exposure to identify and mitigate single\-asset or sector concentration risks.
* Manage Margin Operations: Issue margin calls and instruct the Trade Desk to execute liquidations or coverage for deficient accounts.
* Oversee Proprietary Positions: Track real\-time market risk, leverage, and position limits across proprietary trading accounts.
* Validate Options Processing: Review and confirm option assignments and exercises to ensure accurate settlement and risk alignment.
* Deliver Risk Notifications: Communicate time\-sensitive alerts to clients regarding margin deficiencies, registered account (RRSP) negative balances and liquidations
* Assess Foreign Exchange Exposure: Monitor cross\-currency risk stemming from dual\-currency (USD/CAD) account balances and fluctuations.
* Mitigate Complex Derivatives Risk: Evaluate multi\-leg option strategies and direct the Trade Desk to close out positions posing critical assignment or exercise risk prior to expiry.
* Administer Cease Trade Order (CTO) Restrictions: Coordinate with Compliance and Trade Desk to apply and revoke trading restrictions on halted securities and confirm cancellation of open orders ahead of the evening CTO cutoff.
* Provide Extended\-Hours Support: Act as the primary risk resource for internal teams (Trade Desk, Compliance, Client Success, Sales) during late and extended trading sessions.
* Manage Extended\-Hours Exposure: Monitor market fluctuations and risk limits during pre\-market and after\-hours trading sessions.
* Drive Ad\-Hoc Analytics \& Projects: Conduct ad\-hoc risk reporting, process evaluations, and departmental optimization projects as required.


So are YOU our next Junior Risk \& Credit Analyst? You are if you…
  
* Post secondary degree/diploma in related or quantitative field
* CSI course completion is an asset (CSC, DFC, OLC)
* 1\+ years of financial industry experience
* 1\+ years experience in Risk
* A strong interest in and knowledge of the financial industry
* Strong interpersonal skill, ability to articulate complex information in a clear and concise manner
* Excellent MS Excel skill and G\-suite, Python, SQL, Power\-bi experience is preferred
* Working towards CFA/FRM designation is preferred


Additional Information…
  
* Fix term contract \- 12 months
* Hours: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM EST


**Compensation Information:**  

* Base salary range: $55,000 \- $60,000
* The final compensation package will be commensurate with the successful candidate's experience, skills, and geographic location (Canada). It includes a comprehensive benefits plan and a competitive incentive (bonus) program for Full\-Time Permanent roles.

jobs.title: Représentant(e) du soutien technique / Technical Support Representative
jobs.description:
À propos d'Asteris
Asteris est un chef de file des technologies d'imagerie vétérinaire. Notre suite logicielle Keystone PACS permet aux cliniques, aux hôpitaux et aux spécialistes vétérinaires de stocker, de consulter, de partager et d'interpréter leurs images diagnostiques, des radiographies aux échographies et aux tomodensitométries, facilement et en toute sécurité, où qu'ils soient. Conçu spécifiquement pour le secteur vétérinaire, Keystone s'intègre aux principaux logiciels de gestion de pratique et soutient des flux de téléconsultation qui aident les vétérinaires à prendre des décisions médicales en toute confiance. Asteris fait partie de Valsoft Corporation, qui acquiert et fait croître des entreprises de logiciels de marchés verticaux.


Le poste
À titre de représentant(e) du soutien technique, vous aiderez les cliniques vétérinaires à assurer le bon fonctionnement de leurs flux de travail d'imagerie. Vous résoudrez les problèmes liés aux installations, aux intégrations et à la connectivité de Keystone PACS, et offrirez le soutien rapide et courtois sur lequel nos clients comptent, y compris dans les situations urgentes où les soins aux patients en dépendent.


Vos responsabilités* Répondre aux demandes de soutien des clients par téléphone, par courriel et au moyen du système de billetterie, et résoudre les problèmes rapidement
* Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes logiciels, réseau et de connectivité touchant le stockage, le transfert et la visualisation des images
* Soutenir les installations, les mises à niveau et les intégrations avec les modalités d'imagerie et les logiciels de gestion de pratique
* Installer, configurer et entretenir les systèmes des clients, et effectuer les mises à jour et les sauvegardes afin de protéger l'intégrité et la sécurité des données
* Gérer les comptes utilisateurs, les autorisations et les accès
* Documenter et suivre chaque demande dans le système de billetterie, et rédiger des articles clairs pour la base de connaissances
* Former les clients sur les fonctionnalités de Keystone, les nouvelles versions et les pratiques exemplaires
* Transmettre les problèmes complexes à l'équipe de développement et en assurer le suivi jusqu'à leur résolution

Asteris is part of Valsoft Corporation, which acquires and grows vertical market software companies.

What You'll Do* Respond to client support requests by phone, email, and ticketing system, and resolve issues quickly
* Troubleshoot software, network, and connectivity issues affecting image storage, transfer, and viewing
* Support installations, upgrades, and integrations with imaging modalities and practice management systems
* Install, configure, and maintain client systems, and perform updates and backups to protect data integrity and security
* Manage user accounts, permissions, and access
* Document and track every issue in the ticketing system, and write clear knowledge base articles
* Train clients on Keystone features, new releases, and best practices
* Escalate complex issues to Development and follow through to resolution
* Participate in an after\-hours / on\-call rotation for emergency support
* Share recurring issues and client feedback to help improve the product

  

**Requirements**  

  

Ce que vous apportez* Deux ans ou plus d'expérience en soutien technique, en centre de services ou en TI, idéalement auprès de clients de logiciels
* Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes dans des environnements Windows, en réseautique (TCP/IP, DNS, pare\-feu) et avec les outils de soutien à distance
* Communication claire et patiente avec des utilisateurs non techniques
* Grand sens des responsabilités et du suivi, et calme sous pression
* Expérience avec un système de billetterie


Atouts* Expérience avec les systèmes DICOM, PACS ou d'imagerie médicale
* Expérience dans le secteur vétérinaire ou des technologies de la santé
* Connaissance de SQL ou de la programmation de scripts de base


—


What You Bring* 2\+ years of technical support, help desk, or IT experience, ideally supporting software customers
* Solid troubleshooting skills across Windows environments, networking (TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls), and remote support tools
* Clear, patient communication with non\-technical users
* Strong ownership and follow\-through, with a calm approach under pressure
* Experience with a ticketing system


Nice to Have* Experience with DICOM, PACS, or medical imaging systems
* Background in veterinary or healthcare technology
* Familiarity with SQL or basic scripting

Ce que nous offrons* Salaire de base concurrentiel

jobs.title: Technical Support Analyst
jobs.description:
**Why DUCA?**

We're a vibrant, exciting credit union that lives its "profits with a purpose" philosophy in every financial transaction, product, interest rate, and community initiative we offer. Founded in 1954, DUCA has grown from a single branch credit union in Toronto to 19 branches across Southern Ontario with over 85,000 Members we are proud to serve.


We exist to help People, Businesses and Communities **Do More, Be More, and Achieve More™**.


DUCA (www.duca.com) is distinguished for the following:


* Positive, un\-big bank like service experience delivered through Member\-facing staff in branch, on the phone (Member\-Connect) and via our Mobile mortgage specialists, Wealth Management advisors and Commercial and Business Banking Account Managers.
* Competitive rates.
* Personalized financial solutions, guidance, and service with the lowest possible fees for both Personal and Business Members.
* Profit sharing among Members.
* Multiple ways to bank\-online, mobile app, phone/full\-service Member Connect Contact Centre, and, of course, in\-branch\-DUCA is accessible 24/7
* A community philosophy of "profits with a purpose" culminating in the creation of the DUCA Impact Lab (www.ducaimpactlab.com), a charitable foundation committed to helping the credit challenged and underbanked. This led to DUCA's designation as a B\-Corp certified organization, the first ever credit union to receive this global recognition.


A career with DUCA means you'll find endless opportunities to make a difference with your unique abilities and perspectives. **Our people live their purpose while helping others Do more, Be more and Achieve more with their money and their lives.** At DUCA, you'll be part of a vibrant and collaborative team where you'll be supported to excel and make an impact, no matter what role you play.


**Technical Support Analyst**

**DUCA is looking for a Technical Support Analyst** **to join our growing team!**

**Job Purpose \& Summary**

The Technical Support Analyst provides helpdesk support to DUCA employees by resolving hardware and software issues remotely and in person, via phone, remote support tools, and DUCA's ticketing system. The incumbent will use their experience and knowledge of Windows and other software to troubleshoot various software and hardware issues.



Demonstrating a customer\-service approach, the Technical Support Analyst pays close attention to details while troubleshooting problems and communicates effectively with employees at all levels of the organization.


**Key Accountabilities \& Duties**

* Provide end\-user facing desktop support for all internal clients
* Record, track, triage, escalate, and update employee IT requests using DUCA's Help Desk ticketing system
* Respond to all users in a timely manner and troubleshoot tickets efficiently and professionally, demonstrating a strong service\-orientation and adherence to corporate IT standards
* Provide remote technical support using remote control tools
* Track and resolve multiple competing priorities while keeping end users updated on the progress of their open requests
* Document issue resolution progress via detailed notes on steps taken in tickets
* Hardware deployment, relocation and configuration
* Onboard and offboard users within DUCA's network
* Administer and audit access to various websites and programs
* Communicate technical challenges and issues in a way that is clearly understood by DUCA employees at all levels; create instructions and other documents in a clear and easy to follow manner
* Assist with IT projects
* Occasional visits to DUCA branch locations to provide technical support or attend to and transport IT related equipment to and from


**Occupational Experience \& Education Requirements**

* Post secondary education in a related technical field
* 3\+ years of technical support experience
* Experience in using and supporting Windows 10/Windows Server 2016/2019
* Experience imaging Desktops/Laptops
* Experience configuring Network/Standalone Printers
* Experience using Help Desk software
* Experience in AD, Azure AD, Microsoft Endpoint and M365/O365 administration
* SharePoint, Bell Total Connect, and Bell On Demand Contact Centre (ODCC) administration is an asset
* Microsoft Certification (Windows 10 desktop support / Azure / 365\)
* Experience / certification in Mac OS and iOS support
* Experience using Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Management is an asset
* A\+ / Network\+ / Server\+ certification is an asset
* Prior experience working within a Financial Institution an asset
* Experience supporting Central 1 Member Direct or another online banking system an asset


**Knowledge, Skills \& Attributes**


* Demonstrated strong proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of products
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Team\-player with a customer\-service mindset who enjoys helping people and collaborating with others
* Demonstrated trouble shooting problem solving, critical thinking, and analytical skills
* Ability to prioritize and manage workload to meet established service standards
* Knowledge of Active Directory, Group permissions and NTFS file system permissions
* Basic understanding of Group Policy
* Basic understanding TCP/IP networking
* Strong ability to track multiple competing priorities and keep end users updated on the progress of their open requests
* Ability to keep detailed notes on steps taken in tickets
* Demonstrated ability to create easy to follow documentation


**Working Conditions**


* Ability to travel to DUCA's branches as required with the ability to transport printers, desktop computers, etc. when needed, to support a service call;
* Driver's license and access to a vehicle required
* Rotating evening and weekend availability is required to provide paid on\-call support
* Some work under desks and/or lifting (up to 40lbs) required when deploying workstations


**Department:** Information Technology


**Primary Location:** Corporate

jobs.title: IT Support Auxiliary
jobs.description:
**Role:** IT Support Auxiliary


**Reports** **to:** Manager, Systems Technology


**Location:** Toronto, Canada


**Compensation:** $19\.00 per hour

  


**Description:**



Reporting to the Manager, Systems Technology, the IT Support Auxiliary works as part of the Global IT Systems Support team. The IT Support Auxiliary is responsible for coordinating with key members of the Systems Support team to manage local hardware, software, and IT infrastructure at the campus where the role is based.

  

The successful candidate will be organized, motivated, and able to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization. They will be able to translate business needs into effective technical solutions for client groups, while applying a practical, solutions\-oriented approach when making recommendations and collaborating with fellow members of the Systems Support team.

  


**Job Duties:**



The duties of this position include, but are not limited to:


* Identifies issues staff are having with hardware software and resolves where possible.
* Acts as the primary local escalation point to the Systems Support team
* Logs into the ServiceDesk ticket management system to review, resolve, and or escalate tickets for local campus.
* Participates in the evaluation, recommendation, piloting, testing and launch of new hardware, software and apps Participates in various IT initiatives, helpdesk/desktop projects and research assigned.
* Is the liaison with the Systems Team and primary communication point to local staff during major production issues, upgrades, or scheduled downtime
* Ready to research questions using online searches, manuals, publications and variety of resources, including other IT staff and vendors to troubleshoot and answer customer questions.
* Manages, maintains and improves technical documentation
* Coordinates with vendors and service providers for in\-warranty hardware replacement and service.
* Follows standard guidelines to install and configure new equipment and peripherals, moving and updating equipment for regular replacement and to accommodate staff moves and changes.
* Think outside the box to help improve processes, implement new technologies, and develop innovative solutions.
* Builds positive relationships – works to build or maintain effective relationships or networks with internal or external partners whose cooperation is important to present/future success.
* Team\-oriented and shows initiative and creativity.
* Other duties as assigned.

  


**Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Attributes:**


* Experience with Microsoft Windows 10/11, Office products 2019 \& 365, Apple OSX
* Windows Active Directory User and Computer Administration desirable
* MS Exchange/Outlook user account administration
* Experience with 365 in a hybrid platform desirable
* Familiar with media streaming devices and systems
* Able to prioritize expectations and recognizes when issues/events may affect delivery
* Continually seeks opportunities to increase customer satisfaction and deepen client relationships
* Ability to work independently and in a team

  



**Contact Information:**



 While we thank all applicants, only those who are shortlisted will be contacted.

  


**About ILSC, ELS, Greystone College \& Greystone Institute**



A world leader in language education \& vocational training, ILSC Education Group, which opened its first language school in Vancouver, Canada in 1991 and Greystone College in 2002, offers life\-changing educational experiences in Canada, Australia, Ireland and India, some of the world’s most attractive and popular English\-speaking work and study destinations. Since opening its first school in Vancouver, BC, Canada, ILSC has become a world leader in language and career training and has grown to include 10 incredible locations around the world, in Vancouver, Toronto and Montréal, Canada; New Delhi, India; and Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne, Adelaide and Perth, Australia; and Dublin, Ireland; as well as two online language schools, ILSC HELLO and ILSC ALLO. ELS now has the most extensive network of on\-campus English language programs and University partners, across the USA.

jobs.title: IT Field Service Technician - Kelowna
jobs.description:
**Northern Computer Inc. (NCI)** is a leading Managed IT Services Provider dedicated to delivering exceptional technology solutions and support to businesses across British Columbia and Alberta. We pride ourselves on building strong client relationships, maintaining a collaborative team culture, and providing opportunities for professional growth and development.


We're looking for a motivated and customer\-focused Field Service Technician to join our growing team. If you enjoy working directly with clients, solving technical challenges, and being on the move rather than sitting behind a desk all day, we want to hear from you.

**Job Summary:**


Northern Computer’s Field Services team delivers on site expertise that keeps our clients productive and confident in their technology. You’ll be the face on site when it comes to resolving issues, completing proactive visits, installing gear, closing the loop in our systems, and partnering closely with the Service Desk, NOC/SOC, Projects, and Account Management. The role blends Tier 2 troubleshooting with disciplined documentation and client relationship skills.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Perform onsite technical support as the primary technician for client environments, handling Tier 1\- 2 issues.
* Diagnose, repair, and validate fixes for endpoint, network edge, and infrastructure problems.
* Complete proactive site visits on a regular cadence (weekly/biweekly/monthly/quarterly), documenting findings and routing follow ups.
* Install and stage hardware including server racks, access points, switches, firewalls, servers, and peripheral equipment.
* Execute device adds/moves/changes and support scheduled deployments in coordination with NOC, Service Desk, and Projects.
* Maintain high\-quality ticketing practices: clear documentation, time entries, photos, notes, and next steps.
* Update and validate IT Glue documentation after each onsite visit and whenever configurations change.
* Communicate clearly with end users and site contacts, providing professional, confidence building onsite interactions.
* Ensure that no hardware is left behind and maintain safe, well\-organized tools, loaner kits, and the company vehicle.
* Surface opportunities, risks, and project/quote needs to AM/TDM/SDM with complete context.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* Minimum 3 years of IT Field Services experience.
* Minimum 3 years supporting business technology environments.
* Tier 2 to Tier 3 technical support experience.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and customer service abilities.
* Valid driver's license with a clean driving record.
* Ability to lift 50 lbs.
* Ability to travel up to 75% of the time.

**Why Join Us:**

* Competitive salary and company provided vehicle.
* Extended health, dental, vision, life insurance, RRSP match, EAP, and paid time off.
* Work with a collaborative Service Desk, NOC/SOC, and Projects ecosystem.
* Clear expectations, KPIs, and structured growth paths within Northern Computer’s Field Services team.

**Benefits:**

* Company car
* Dental care
* Employee assistance program
* Extended health care
* Life insurance
* On\-site parking
* Paid time off
* RRSP match
* Vision care


Experience:

* MSP: 2 years (required)


Language:

* English (required)


License/Certification:

* Driving License (required)


Willingness to travel:

* 75% (required)




* Work Location: In person

jobs.title: IT Support Specialist (St Thomas Office)
jobs.description:
Who we are
  
  

For over 70 years Buckland has been working to help companies across the world experience global trade in a better way. Buckland employs a unique approach to global trade that focuses on combining trusted technologies and talented people that know how to use them. As a customer\-focused company, Buckland provides customers with a single source of unmatched Customs Brokerage (Canadian, US, Mexican), Trade Managed Solutions, Freight Forwarding, Trade Technologies and Warehousing/Distribution Services. Buckland strives to provide customized services in a memorable way.
  
  

Buckland is looking for an IT Support Specialist (St Thomas Office)
  
  

What you’ll be doing
  
This position is responsible for following ITIL/ITSM best practices, to identify, resolve issues and deliver improvements. The IT Support Specialist will engage with lines of business and teams to prioritize and complete service requests and support incidents and internal and external OLA’s and SLAs are met. IT Support Specialist are involved in remote and onsite support, documentation, constructing reference material, and provide trainings as necessary.
  
  

What we can offer you
  
* Competitive salary, benefits package, and matching retirement plan
* Compensation range: $55,000– $65,000 annually (subject to experience)
* A friendly, collaborative work environment
* Opportunities for professional development \& ongoing learning
* A chance to be part of a growing organization
* On\-site position


Key Responsibilities
  
* Field incoming helpdesk requests from end users via ticketing system, phone or in person.
* Installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of Windows systems.
* Assist with configuration, installation and maintenance of software, hardware, and telecommunications services such as: computers, software applications, printers, telephones, servers, and general office equipment.
* Participate in reviewing systems, testing, and deploying updates.
* Follow ITIL/ITSM best practices for incident management, problem management, and continuous service improvement.
* Taking team and staff needs and improving solutions through planning, design, review, and installation tasks.
* Creating detailed documentation of IT resources and processes and updating support documentation with all daily tasks and as the product support grows.
* Fulfil requests coming from team members and leads to ensure hardware, software and network are available 98\+% of the time on a 24/7 basis, excluding scheduled downtime.
* Collaborate with other IT teams, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure seamless integration of support services and incident management processes.
* Provide afterhours on\-call support as required.
* Other responsibilities as assigned.


What we need from you
  
* Computer Science degree or diploma or equivalent education and work experience.
* 2\+ years of relevant work experience in a technical support position.
* ITIL Foundations certification.
* Knowledge of ITSM processes, tools, and best practices.
* Networking fundamentals or proven networking certification.
* Microsoft 365, PowerShell scripting and Azure experience.
* Experience with Virtual server technologies such as VMWare, Cloud Infrastructure, Microsoft Exchange online or equivalent cloud\-based system.
* Experience with Windows enterprise applications, Active Directory, IIS, file servers, etc.
* Experience in Microsoft SQL Server.
* Desktop support for PC environment supporting Windows 10 / 11 and Microsoft Office suite.
* Networking involving multiple platforms, Cisco/Nortel/HP/Dell/other vendors.
* Excellent problem solving and decision\-making skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Must be legally eligible to work for the Company at all times.
* Valid Passport ability to occasionally travel if required to other offices locations in CAD/USA/MEX.


Want to apply? Get in touch today
  
Please visit www.Buckland.com to apply to this current and open vacancy and to learn more about Buckland and the services we provide. The career page will highlight all current open positions and they can be found in this link. When applying, ensure to have your most up to date resume and all relevant documents related to your application ready to be uploaded.
  
Buckland provides equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on any protected ground under applicable human rights legislation. Applicants do not require CAD or USA work experience but for some positions may require CAD or USA standard regulations knowledge and experience. This applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, placement, promotion, compensation, transfer, leaves of absence, layoff, recall and termination.
  
Buckland may use artificial intelligence from time to time to screen, assess, or select applicants for employment, including for this position.
  
Buckland will work with and accommodate persons with disabilities throughout the entire recruitment, selection, and on\-boarding process. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition at TA@Buckland.com
  
As we receive a high volume of applications, we’re only able to contact candidates selected to move forward. While we truly appreciate your interest, we are unable to respond to general inquiries regarding application status. Thank you for your understanding.

**About Mobiltex**

Mobiltex is an IIoT and software company delivering remote monitoring and software solutions that help maintain pipeline health for industries delivering critical services. Individual solutions target corrosion prevention, gas pressure management, and water network optimization, primarily serving midstream and downstream energy operators, and water utilities.

Mobiltex is a high\-growth company in an active phase of product and organizational scaling, with potential for M\&A, as well as a growing international footprint. This is an environment that rewards people who can build structure where it doesn’t yet exist, and drive commercial output as the organization scales.

**Role Summary**

The **Technical Support Specialist** **– Software** is a frontline role responsible for delivering technical support and training, while serving as a critical link between the customers and service, engineering, sales, and product teams. It combines software support expertise with customer engagement to support deployment, adoption, and ongoing performance of IoT solutions across our energy and water verticals.

This is an early\-career role in the support team, reporting to the Support Manager. It's a strong entry point for someone with technical skills who enjoys working with people to build product and troubleshooting expertise and grow into a senior support or implementation role over time. The primary focus will be support of Mobiltex software and will include some support of Mobiltex hardware devices. This position is also a great fit for corrosion/CP field professionals looking to move into support, or for IT helpdesk, telecom, electronics, or customer service people with strong technical curiosity; we'll train the domain side either way.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide technical support across the software portfolio: primarily CorInsights, and also FloInsights, Osprey, and future products. Secondarily, provide hardware support as needed for CorTalk, FloPath, and future products.
* Respond to support tickets with a focus on responsiveness, clarity, and resolution quality.
* Communicate clearly with customers, translating technical issues into understandable terms and helping customers use our products successfully.
* Diagnose problems methodically and identify root causes, workarounds, and solutions.
* Escalate complex or high\-impact issues to senior support, management, sales, or engineering.

**How You'll Work**

You will use phone, email, and ticketing systems to communicate with customers and track resolutions and defects internally. There will be occasional opportunities for on\-site customer engagement. Strong verbal and written communication skills are fundamental to success.

You'll learn and use AI tools like Claude and Copilot alongside standard support tools to work faster and more consistently: drafting case responses, summarizing ticket threads before escalation, searching the knowledge base for similar issues, and generating first\-draft articles from resolved cases for peer review and publishing.

**Qualifications**

* 2–4 years of experience in software customer support or service technician roles.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.

* Experience with support ticketing systems, remote desktop tools, and diagnostic utilities (Salesforce, Teams, Slack, Jira, Confluence).
* Troubleshooting skills with knowledge of SaaS platforms, APIs, and database technologies.
* Knowledge of and/or willingness to use, create, and promote knowledge bases and AI tools (Claude, Copilot).

* Competitive compensation including base salary and performance incentives.

jobs.title: IT Technician
jobs.description:
IT Technician – L1/L2

**Company:** ExcellIT  
**Location:** Brampton, ON  
**Work Setting:** Onsite at Client Location  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

About ExcellIT

ExcellIT is seeking a reliable, hands\-on **IT Technician** to join our growing team. The successful candidate will work **onsite at one of our client locations in Brampton**, providing professional technical support directly to end users.

This is a client\-facing position requiring strong troubleshooting skills, excellent communication, and the ability to work independently while knowing when to escalate more complex issues.

The Role

As an **L1/L2 IT Technician**, you will provide day\-to\-day technical support for the client's employees, systems, hardware, and software. You will be responsible for resolving issues efficiently, maintaining accurate documentation, and ensuring users receive a professional and positive IT support experience.

Key Responsibilities

* Provide **Level 1 and Level 2 technical support** to onsite users
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, and connectivity issues
* Troubleshoot Windows desktops, laptops, monitors, printers, and peripherals
* Install, configure, maintain, and deploy computers and other IT equipment
* Provide support for **Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, and other business applications**
* Assist with user account creation, password resets, permissions, and access issues
* Troubleshoot LAN, Wi\-Fi, VPN, printers, and basic network connectivity
* Perform workstation setups, upgrades, replacements, and device imaging
* Assist with onboarding and offboarding of employees
* Manage and update support tickets with accurate notes and resolutions
* Maintain IT asset and equipment documentation
* Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements
* Escalate complex technical issues to senior IT staff or external vendors when required
* Provide professional, courteous, and timely onsite customer service
* Assist with IT projects, deployments, and other technical tasks as required

Required Qualifications \& Experience

* **1–3\+ years of experience in IT support, help desk, desktop support, or a similar role**
* Demonstrated **L1/L2 troubleshooting experience**
* Strong knowledge of **Windows 10/11**
* Working knowledge of **Microsoft 365**
* Experience troubleshooting computers, printers, peripherals, and common software issues
* Basic understanding of networking fundamentals, including **TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi\-Fi, and VPN**
* Familiarity with **Active Directory / Entra ID** is an asset
* Experience working with an IT ticketing system is an asset
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving abilities
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong customer service skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to work independently in an onsite client environment
* Ability to prioritize multiple requests and manage competing deadlines

Assets

* CompTIA A\+, Network\+, or Microsoft certifications
* Experience with Microsoft Intune
* Experience with Active Directory / Entra ID
* Experience with Microsoft 365 administration
* Previous MSP or managed IT services experience
* Previous experience providing onsite client support

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is **professional, dependable, personable, and technically capable**. You should enjoy helping people, be comfortable working directly with clients, and have the confidence to troubleshoot issues independently.

The successful candidate will represent **ExcellIT** directly at the client site, so professionalism, communication, and customer service are just as important as technical ability.

Work Location

**Brampton, Ontario – Onsite at Client Location**

This is an **onsite position** and requires the successful candidate to be comfortable working at the client's location on a daily basis.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume through Indeed. Qualified candidates will be contacted for an interview.

Pay: $50,000\.00\-$55,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Service Desk Administrator 1
jobs.description:
**SERVICE DESK ADMINISTRATOR \- LEVEL 1**  

**MANAGED SERVICES \| TECHNICAL SUPPORT**  

**Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada**


Convergence Networks is one of North America’s leading managed service and managed security providers. We are a service company focused on helping clients leverage technology as a strategic tool and proactively protecting their business. We are fueled by providing outstanding service and sharing our passion for innovative technology as part of our integrated solutions.

**POSITION SUMMARY**


The Service Desk Administrator (SDA) is responsible for providing excellent customer experience by responding to and resolving incoming IT requests and alerts from our customers over the phone, through email, and in person. You will work on a variety of technical issues, from diagnosing network, server, and workstation problems, to thinking outside of the box to troubleshoot solutions and resolving complex problems.


This job operates at a very fast pace, and you must be comfortable handling high volumes of request tickets and phone calls. This position is similar to a Help Desk Analyst, Tier 1 Help Desk or Junior Network Administrator and offers many opportunities to advance within Convergence.

**WHAT WILL YOU DO AS A SERVICE DESK ADMINISTRATOR?**

* Answer a high\-volume of inbound phone calls and emails from clients and perform initial troubleshooting on help desk tickets.
* Resolve customer tickets on the first contact, but also be able to determine when issue scope requires that a ticket be escalated to a System or Network Administrator or other support resource.
* Maintain accurate records on communication, resolution, assistance needed and follow\-up.
* Ensure customer satisfaction with service, communication and issue resolution.
* Other relevant job duties as assigned.

**WHAT SKILLS DO I NEED TO BE A SUCCESSFUL SERVICE DESK ADMINISTRATOR?**

* Empathy, patience, and willingness to learn
* IT background with a focus on network support, implementation, and remote as well as onsite support.
* Familiarity with Active Directory and MS 365 Portal
* Understanding of networking
* Familiarity with Group Policy
* Technical prowess
* Documenting
* Familiarity with a ticketing and RMM system
* Familiarity with Event Viewer (checking for errors, reviewing logs)
* Familiarity with Windows OS and common applications
* Experience with administering current Windows desktop operating systems, Windows server operating systems, Exchange, Office 365, and a variety of backup solutions, routers, firewalls, and virtual/cloud\-based technologies.
* Experience using a triaging or priority system to gauge client issues and impact.
* Apple OSX and iOS experience.
* Ability to work effectively within a team as well as independently.
* Understanding of managed services and the value offered over a typical break\-fix environment.
* Excellent communication (verbal and written)
* Skilled at defusing high\-stress situations and facilitating resolution to technical problems.
* Willingness to learn, adjust, and grow with our company.
* Self\-starter with a positive attitude.

**WHAT QUALIFICATIONS DO I NEED TO HAVE?**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* 2\+ years of relevant experience which may include Service Desk Support Specialist, Help Desk Technician, Help Desk Analyst, or Tier 2 (or similar) in a tiered environment.
* Excellent troubleshooting skills with IT and related hardware and software components (PCs, laptops, servers, firewalls, switches, routers, hard drives, Windows operating systems, etc.).
* Previous experience providing both onsite and remote/phone support in a fast paced, high volume environment.

**WHAT QUALIFICATIONS WOULD REALLY HELP SET ME APART FROM OTHER APPLICANTS?**

* Associate’s degree/College diploma or higher in Information Technology.
* Understanding of, and a background in working within the IT managed services provider business model, particularly in an IT support role.
* Experience with ConnectWise, Kaseya, or other similar MSP tools and software.
* Knowledge and experience working with Microsoft Office 365, Microsoft Azure and other Cloud service offerings.

**WHAT IS THE WORK ENVIRONMENT LIKE?**

* Normal office working conditions. Work requires regular sitting/standing at a desk, working with a computer. This position requires standing, walking, sitting, using hands, seeing, reaching, talking, writing, and hearing; it may require occasionally carrying or lifting equipment (10\-50 pounds) if working on\-site.
* Position may require hours that exceed normal working hours per day during peak periods; on\-call or travel work may include nights or weekends
* Position requires regular contact with others \- in meetings, by phone or by email.
* Interactions focus on data collection, problem solving, needs analysis and technical training development. Interactions are initiated in person or electronically.
* Position may require some travel to Convergence or client sites.

**WHY SHOULD YOU WORK HERE?**

* Culture of unity, transparency, and trust. Our leadership team wants you to be successful at Convergence, and we will do anything we can to support your personal and professional growth.
* Group benefits plans including medical, dental, vision, and 401k.
* Education and certification reimbursement is also available so we can help you grow.
* We believe feedback makes us better. You can expect regular meetings with your manager and quarterly conversations about your performance and growth.
* Outstanding teammates. We’re very selective to make sure we have the best staff available for you to work alongside!
* Many teambuilding and company events throughout the year so you can get to know your teammates on a more personal level, as well as kick back and have some fun (families are oftentimes included as well).

**PERFECT FIT…**


If this sounds like your type of place and you can wow us with your spectacular skill set, then we would love to hear from you!


We are an eq

jobs.title: Junior IT Infrastructure Technician
jobs.description:
**About Sync**  

Sync is a Canadian company building zero\-knowledge, end\-to\-end encrypted cloud storage and collaboration for over two million people and businesses worldwide. Unlike most of our competitors, we own and operate our own storage infrastructure rather than renting it. Our customers’ data lives on our hardware, in our racks, in Canada. That is a core part of our product promise, and it means the physical infrastructure is not a back\-office concern here. It is the product.  

  

**About the role**  

We are hiring a Junior IT Infrastructure Technician to help maintain the JBODs, servers, and network gear in our Toronto colocation facility. This is a hybrid role based in Toronto, with regular travel to our Toronto Data Centre required to do hands\-on work, and a genuinely strong entry point into storage and infrastructure engineering, you will be working directly on petabyte\-scale storage systems from your first week.  

  

You will rack and maintain hardware, replace failed drives and components, own the RMA process end to end, manage procurement, and support the day\-to\-day IT needs of the team. We are looking for someone early in their career who is curious about how things work and who moves toward problems instead of waiting to be assigned them. You will not be expected to arrive knowing everything. You will be expected to ask good questions, document what you learn, and take real ownership of the things you touch. Once you're ramped up, this role will also include participation in an on\-call rotation.  

  

**What you will do*** Maintain our JBOD storage enclosures: identify and replace failed drives, verify rebuilds complete cleanly, and track drive health and failure trends over time.
* Install, cable, configure, provision and decommission servers and storage chassis in our Toronto colocation cage.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware faults across drives, memory, PSUs, HBAs, SAS expanders, backplanes, and network components.
* Support network infrastructure: rack and cable switches, maintain accurate port maps, and assist with configuration changes under supervision.
* Support the team during critical situations: respond to monitoring alerts, work the relevant runbook, and help recover systems from unexpected failures.
* Own the RMA process end to end: identify the failure, open the case with the vendor, track the shipment, install the replacement, and confirm the fix. Then make sure the inventory reflects reality.
* Manage procurement for hardware and IT equipment, including quoting, purchase orders, receiving, and day\-to\-day vendor communication.
* Maintain an accurate asset inventory covering serial numbers, warranty status, rack and slot locations, and lifecycle state.
* Keep the cage clean and auditable through disciplined structured cabling, labelling, and cable management.
* Handle media sanitization and secure disposal of decommissioned drives in line with our security policies.
* Coordinate with the colocation provider on remote hands, access approvals, power and cooling questions, and scheduled maintenance windows.
* Provide general IT support to internal staff, including laptop provisioning, account setup, and endpoint troubleshooting.
* Write and improve runbooks so the next person can do the task without having to ask.
* Participate in an on\-call rotation for incidents after an onboarding period.

**What we are looking for*** 0 to 2 years of experience in IT support, datacenter operations, or a related hands\-on technical role. Co\-op terms, internships, home labs, and personal projects all count.
* A proactive mindset. You notice the drive that keeps throwing errors before it fails outright, and you raise it.
* Real curiosity about infrastructure. You want to understand why a system behaves the way it does, not just which button restarts it.
* Working knowledge of server and storage hardware, and comfort using hand tools in a rack environment.
* Linux fundamentals at the command line: navigating the filesystem, reading logs with journalctl and dmesg, and using basic disk and filesystem tooling such as lsblk, smartctl and df.
* Basic networking knowledge: IP addressing, VLANs, switching, subnetting, routing and the ability to read and maintain a cable map.
* Care and precision around data. In a live storage environment, pulling the wrong drive matters — we need someone who checks twice before executing any task.
* Clear written communication. A significant part of this job is leaving a good record for the next person.
* Strong organizational habits, particularly around tracking assets, tickets, and open vendor cases.
* Ability to work on\-site in Toronto and to lift and position equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.
* Eligibility to work in Canada.

**Nice to have*** Exposure to a colocation or datacenter environment.
* Familiarity with SAS or SATA storage topologies, RAID or erasure coding concepts, or distributed storage systems such as ZFS or Ceph.
* Scripting in Bash or Python to automate repetitive work such as drive health checks or inventory reconciliation.
* Experience with out\-of\-band management tools such as iDRAC, iLO, or IPMI.
* Any exposure to a switch CLI – Cisco NX\-OS or IOS, HP ProCurve, or similar –even if only show commands.
* Any exposure to monitoring and alerting tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix.
* Familiarity with Containers (Docker, LXC) or with a directory and identity service for user and device management.
* Certifications such as CompTIA A\+, Network\+, Server\+, or equivalent coursework.

**Perks:*** Compensation range: $50,000 to $58,000 CAD
* Generous WSA program
* Best\-in\-the\-class health benefits
* Paid vacation with carry\-over
* Flexible Hybrid
* Direct hands\-on experience with petabyte\-scale storage infrastructure that very few companies our size operate themselves.
* A clear growth path toward storage, systems, or network engineering, with mentorship from the senior staff who built this infrastruct

We welcome applications from third\- and fourth\-year Computer Science or Electrical Engineering undergraduate students, students seeking a co\-op placement, and recent graduates beginning their careers in software quality assurance.


Reporting to the QA Manager, the **Junior QA Specialist** will work directly with software developers and other departments while receiving guidance in software life\-cycle testing activities such as reviewing requirements, writing test plans, performing regression testing, identifying defects, and preparing clear defect reports.


This is a role that will be contributing to the overall quality of DDS’ products where an immediate impact will be seen by not only the stakeholders but also our customers. Yes, this sounds challenging, yet a rewarding experience to help you grow in your career! Join and grow with us today!

 **How You Will Help**

* Support software life\-cycle testing activities, including reviewing requirements, writing and updating test cases, performing regression testing, identifying and logging defects, and preparing clear defect reports for transit products, with guidance from experienced team members
* Assist with reviewing software requirements and designs and identifying considerations that may affect testability
* Create, maintain, and execute functional test cases for our software products with support from the QA team
* Identifying, documenting, and tracking software defects
* Working closely with our Customer Service department to reproduce customer issues
* Working with software developers to ensure defects are correctly identified, fixed and incorporated into product builds

* Learn about and assist with DDS test automation activities based on your interests and current technical skills
**Page Break** **Must Haves**

* Currently enrolled in the third or fourth year of a Computer Science or Electrical Engineering undergraduate program, eligible for a co\-op placement, or recently graduated from a related program
* Ability to adapt to a fast\-paced environment
* Good communication skills, both written and verbal, are required

* Basic understanding of software testing or QA concepts gained through coursework, personal projects, internships, co\-op experience, or equivalent hands\-on learning
* Interest in learning how software teams collaborate using Agile development practices
* Basic familiarity with SQL through coursework, projects, or practical experience, with a willingness to develop these skills
* Passionate about software quality

* Ability to document work clearly and willingness to learn DDS documentation practices
 **Nice\-To\-Have**

* Exposure to REST APIs through coursework, projects, or previous experience
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or similar collaboration tools is helpful but not required
* Interest in or introductory exposure to cloud technologies such as AWS
* Experience with test automation, or AI assisted testing
* Experience testing large scale software platforms, such as transaction processing systems, web applications, mobile applications,
**What We Want From You**


We’d love to see a brief cover letter explaining your interest in software quality assurance and how your coursework, projects, volunteer work, previous employment, or other experiences could help you contribute and learn in this position. Please highlight relevant technical skills, training, and what you hope to gain from the opportunity.

jobs.title: Junior Software Developer
jobs.description:
**Apply:** Geologic Career Centre

 **Geologic** is a trusted data, software, and information solutions company committed to the Energy Industry. Everyday we provide global customers with market\-leading data, software, platforms, analytics, education, news, and insights that enable them to make vital decisions that drive growth and efficiency. Based in Calgary, with offices in London (UK) and Houston (US), we deliver critical data\-driven intelligence ranging from surface and subsurface well/asset level information \& insights to corporate performance benchmarking data and A\&D transaction data.


People make us successful. We're driven by a team of individuals whose unique backgrounds and experience allow us to provide the best products and customer service on the market. Together we're transforming the energy intelligence landscape.

 **The Role**

  

We're building a new cloud\-first product, designed from the ground up on modern technology with AI at its core, and we're looking for a **Junior Software Developer** to grow with it. You don't need years of industry experience. You do need solid fundamentals, real curiosity, and evidence that you enjoy solving hard problems, whether that comes from your degree, co\-op or internship terms, personal projects, or open source.


You'll join a small software development team building something new, working alongside senior software developers who will pair with you, review your code, and help you get good quickly.

 **How will you spend your day?**


You'll write and ship real code from early on, starting with well\-scoped pieces of the product and taking on more as you find your feet. You'll work on our cloud\-first product on AWS and get hands\-on exposure to modern AI and agentic approaches as part of everyday development, not as a side project.


Your work will be reviewed, and you'll be expected to ask questions, take feedback well, and learn fast. Over time you'll own features end to end and start contributing to how things are designed, not just how they're built.

 **Ready to apply? Here's what we're looking for:**

* Solid programming fundamentals and a genuine interest in writing good code
* A degree in computer science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Evidence that you like solving problems: school or capstone projects, co\-op and internship work, personal projects, hackathons, open source, or similar
* Curiosity about cloud and AI, and enthusiasm to learn AWS and modern models on the job
* Clear communication, and the willingness to ask questions and act on feedback
* A collaborative attitude and eagerness to learn from more experienced software developers
* Angular, TypeScript, HTML/CSS, Python, SQL, REST APIs, and Git. Project or internship experience counts

  

Nice to haves:

* Exposure to a cloud platform, ideally AWS
* Any hands\-on experimentation with LLMs, AI tooling or agent frameworks, however informal
* Familiarity with version control, testing and code review in a team setting
* An interest in the energy sector, geospatial, or large\-scale data

jobs.title: FIELD SERVICE TECHNICIAN
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**JOB TITLE: FIELD SERVICE TECHNICIAN**

**REPORTING TO: REGIONAL SERVICE MANAGER**

**JOB PURPOSE**:

The Field Service Technician is a member of our CashTech Team responsible for equipment deployments, installation, and on\-going services. A Field Service Technician is a front\-line representative for CashTech and responsible to provide professional and courteous customer service with quality workmanship.

If you are a quality conscious team player, who cares about customer satisfaction, and enjoys troubleshooting to provide solutions, then you are a perfect fit for our team.

**Employee Responsibilities:**

* Represent CashTech in a professional manner while adhering to customer policies and procedures.
* Interacting with Customers while providing the highest level of service and ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.
* Responsible for first line maintenance of various equipment including but not limited to currency recyclers, drop safes, image scanners, printers, safe and Networked PC’s.
* Diagnose, repair, clean and adjust assemblies or subassemblies, restoring unit to functional standards.
* Adhere to escalation policies to ensure customer's SLA’s are met in a timely manner.
* Consistent, accurate, timely electronic service ticket maintenance.
* Ability to work without supervision.
* Work well in a team environment.
* Communicating with Customer Care Centre’s to relay job status upon completion of service calls.
* Identify business leads and promote growth for the company.
* Assist customers with operation and cleaning procedures.
* Manage trunk inventory with accuracy and complete periodic cycle counts.

**Qualifications Required:**

* High School diploma or equivalent required. Post\-secondary degree or certificate preferred.
* Minimum of 1 year experience in assembly and/or repair of electro\-mechanical components including AC and DC voltages and networked computers.
* Clean criminal record check (to be provided by applicant)
* Valid driver’s license, insured and licensed reliable vehicle is required.
* Must be able to work from detailed documentation and/or verbal and written instructions.
* Ability to stand, sit, kneel or bend for extended periods. May need to stand for several hours at a time.
* Ability to lift a maximum of 75 lbs. There is no lifting overhead however should be able to push upwards.
* Ability to use lift equipment, roll bars, and crowbars.
* Ability to use power tools including but not limited to drills, hammer drills. Minor soldering skills are required.
* Ability use of test equipment including digital multi meter.
* Ability to take standby and call outs on scheduled weekends.
* Comfortable with Microsoft office and cloud\-based computing programs.
* Ability to work in a mobile office setting

**Employee Expectations:**

* Use of the provided safety equipment and procedures to protect oneself and others.
* Maintain a professional appearance, both personally and in the work environment for customers and vendors.
* Present oneself in a positive and respectful manner toward co\-workers, customers and vendors.
* Communicate business issues immediately
* Perform daily record keeping and reporting
* Efficient use of time and materials in performing all tasks.
* Daily maintenance of tools, parts and work environment.
* Desire to continually learn and enhance one’s talents and expertise.
* Perform daily record keeping and reporting.
* Establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with those contacted in the course of work, including the public.
* Communicate (written and orally) effectively with both the customer and the company.
* Ability to handle multiple priorities, organize workload, and meet deadlines.

Job Type: Full\-time

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $45,000\.00\-$54,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental care
* Extended health care
* Life insurance
* Paid time off

Experience:

* Service Technician: 3 years (required)

Willingness to travel:

* 75% (required)

Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: Level II Security Systems Technician
jobs.description:
**About New Age Group**  

For more than 25 years, **The New Age Group** has delivered security and technology solutions for residential, commercial, industrial, institutional, and multi\-residential clients. Our expertise includes access control, video surveillance, intrusion alarms, ULC inspections, structured cabling, fiber optics, intercom systems, networking, and integrated technology platforms. We are committed to delivering high\-quality workmanship, innovative solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. Our technicians work with leading manufacturers and technologies while benefiting from ongoing training, certification programs, and clearly defined career progression opportunities.  

  

**Position Summary**  

The **Level II** **Technician** serves as a technical leader within the organization and is responsible for advanced installations, commissioning, troubleshooting, inspections, quality assurance, customer training, and mentoring junior technicians.  

  

This role requires an experienced technician capable of leading complex projects, resolving advanced technical challenges, maintaining high\-quality workmanship, and ensuring all installations meet New Age standards, customer requirements, manufacturer specifications, and applicable industry regulations.  

Level II Technicians play a critical role in technician development, quality control, and customer satisfaction.  

  

**Primary Responsibilities**  

**Technical Leadership*** Provide technical support to field technicians.
* Assist with project planning and execution.
* Mentor Apprentices, Labourers, Technician I, and Technician II personnel.
* Review installation quality and workmanship.
* Support commissioning and technical escalations.
* Assist with manufacturer training initiatives.

  

**Advanced Security Systems**  

**Intrusion Systems*** Advanced troubleshooting of intrusion alarm systems.
* Commission complex alarm installations.
* Resolve communication failures.
* Conduct ULC\-related inspections and testing.
* Support monitoring integrations.

**Access Control Systems*** Configure and commission complex access control systems.
* Troubleshoot controllers, readers, and field devices.
* Support enterprise\-level deployments.
* Verify system performance and functionality.
* Conduct quality assurance inspections.

**Surveillance Systems*** Configure and commission advanced IP surveillance systems.
* Troubleshoot networked video systems.
* Optimize camera layouts and performance.
* Conduct surveillance system audits.
* Verify recording retention and performance standards.

**Fiber Optics**  

Senior Technicians must be capable of:* Fiber troubleshooting
* Fiber certification
* Fiber commissioning
* OTDR testing
* Interpreting OTDR results
* Diagnosing communication failures
* Documenting fiber deficiencies

**System Commissioning*** Commission newly installed systems.
* Verify programming.
* Verify customer requirements are met.
* Conduct acceptance testing.
* Perform final system verification.
* Resolve deficiencies prior to customer onboarding.

**Quality Assurance**  

Senior Technicians are responsible for:* QA inspections
* Workmanship reviews
* Installation audits
* SOP verification
* Deficiency identification
* Corrective action recommendations


The Level II Technician acts as a quality gatekeeper before customer acceptance.  

  

**Customer Training**  

Provide customer training on:* Access Control Systems
* Video Surveillance Systems
* Intrusion Alarm Systems
* Mobile Applications
* User Management
* Basic Troubleshooting
* System Reporting Functions

**Documentation**  

Review and complete:* Service Reports
* Inspection Reports
* Commissioning Reports
* Certification Reports
* Deficiency Reports
* As\-Built Documentation
* Customer Turnover Documentation

**Required Qualifications**  

**Experience*** Minimum 5\+ years of industry experience
* Commercial security systems experience
* Access control experience
* Video surveillance experience
* Structured cabling experience
* Fiber optic experience
* Advanced troubleshooting experience

**Technical Requirements**  

Level II Technicians are expected to demonstrate competency in:* OTDR Testing
* Fiber Certification
* System Commissioning
* Complex Access Control Systems
* Enterprise Surveillance Systems
* Quality Assurance Inspections
* Customer Training
* Project Coordination
* Technical Escalation Support
* Advanced Troubleshooting


These competencies align with New Age's Level II Technician certification requirements.  

  

**Preferred Manufacturer Experience**  

Experience with:* ICT
* Axis Communications
* Milestone XProtect
* CDVI
* Mircom
* DoorGuard
* UniFi Networking

**Required Certifications*** Working at Heights
* WHMIS
* Aerial Lift Certification (Scissor Lift)
* Aerial Lift Certification (Boom Lift)
* Valid Ontario Driver's License

**Preferred Certifications*** ULC Intrusion Certification
* ULC Protective Signalling Systems
* ATC Certification
* ICT Certification
* Axis Certification
* Milestone Certification
* Fiber Certification
* Manufacturer Technical Certifications

**Leadership Responsibilities**  

The Level II Technician is expected to:* Mentor junior staff.
* Verify field workmanship.
* Review technician documentation.
* Assist with technician evaluations.
* Support technician development plans.
* Promote safety and quality standards.

**Safety Responsibilities*** Enforce New Age Health \& Safety policies.
* Conduct Job Hazard Assessments.
* Maintain safe work practices.
* Lead by example.
* Ensure PPE compliance.
* Verify safe use of ladders and aerial lifts.
* Report and correct unsafe conditions.

**Quality Standards**  

Level II Technicians are expected to enforce all New Age installation standards.  

**Zero\-Tolerance Zip Tie Policy**  

Zip ties are not permitted on structured cabling installations.  

Approved methods include:* Velcro Straps
* J\-Hooks
* Basket Tray
* Ladder Tray
* Approved Cable Management

jobs.title: Deskside Operational Tier 2 (Fly-In/Fly-Out Mining Site)
jobs.description:
**What is the Role?**


WBM is seeking an experienced **Deskside Operational Tier 2** resource to support a remote mining operation in Northern BC. This is a hands\-on infrastructure and support role where you will serve as the primary onsite technical resource, supporting network, server, wireless, and end\-user technologies in a camp\-based environment.


This is a **Fly\-In/Fly\-Out position with a 2 weeks on / 2 weeks off rotation**. The successful candidate must be comfortable working independently, supporting critical technology systems, and thriving in a remote mining environment.

**Please Note:** Previous camp experience is required. Experience supporting mining, oil \& gas, industrial, or other remote\-site operations is strongly preferred.

**What You Will Do**

* Provide onsite technical support for infrastructure, networking, wireless, and end\-user systems
* Support and troubleshoot Fortinet environments, including FortiGate firewalls and Forti Switches
* Manage and support SD\-WAN connectivity
* Deploy, configure, and troubleshoot wireless networks and access points
* Perform Wi\-Fi optimization, signal analysis, and wireless troubleshooting
* Support Dell server infrastructure and virtualization environments
* Assist with SAN and storage infrastructure
* Install and configure network, server, and infrastructure equipment
* Deploy and support UPS systems and Starlink solutions
* Complete structured cabling, equipment installations, and hardware deployments
* Troubleshoot infrastructure and connectivity issues across the site
* Act as the primary onsite technical resource and escalation point

**What You Bring**

* 5\+ years of IT infrastructure, systems administration, networking, or field support experience
	+ MSP experience will also be considered
* Strong Fortinet experience, including FortiGate firewalls and FortiSwitches
* Networking knowledge including switching, routing, VLANs, VPNs, DNS, and DHCP
* Experience supporting wireless environments and access point deployments
* Server hardware experience, preferably Dell infrastructure
* Virtualization experience required (Proxmox, VMware, Hyper\-V, or similar)
* Microsoft 365 / Office 365 administration experience
* Strong troubleshooting, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent customer service and communication skills
* Previous mining, oil \& gas, industrial, or remote\-site experience strongly preferred
* Previous camp experience required

**Certifications Considered an Asset**

* Network\+, Security\+, Server\+
* Fortinet Certifications
* MS\-900, AZ\-900
* Other networking, infrastructure, cloud, or security certifications

**Why WBM?**


If you are looking for the following opportunity, we want to hear from you:

* You want to be a member of an elite team of like\-minded technicians focused on delivering an exceptional IT experience.
* You thrive in a performance\-based environment where success is celebrated and career growth is earned.
* You are driven by feedback and continuous improvement.
* You want to be part of a winning team that celebrates successes together.
* You believe the customer experience is just as important as the technical resolution.
* You enjoy solving complex technical challenges and making a meaningful impact for customers.

 **Why Join WBM?**


This is an opportunity to work with emerging AI, automation, and cloud technologies while helping shape the future of WBM's AI and Automation practice. You'll work alongside innovative technical teams delivering solutions that create measurable business impact.

  

  

 WBM is committed to meaningful community engagement across Western Canada. Team members have opportunities to get involved and contribute to community initiatives.  

  

 Only applicants selected for an interview will be contacted. We thank all applicants for their interest in WBM.

jobs.title: Technology Support Technician - Tier I
jobs.description:
At the Trudell Medical Group of Companies our vision is to provide patients throughout the world with medical devices and services that make their lives better. The Group manufactures and globally markets some of the leading brands in respiratory care, including the AeroChamber® brand of valved holding chambers, the Aerobika® brand of OPEP devices, and the AeroEclipse® brand of nebulizers. Trudell Medical Limited is the Corporate entity within the Trudell Medical Group of Companies and operates out of our offices in London, Ontario Canada.
  
  

Technology Support Technician \- Tier I is a role in our Corporate IT Service Desk team.
  
  

This is an office\-based role with the option of a hybrid work arrangement.
  
  

\*\* Must be available to come into the London, Ontario office 4 days per week.
  
  

Your success in this role will be grounded in your values as a person who always acts with integrity and who treats everyone with respect. You continuously improve the systems and processes around you, and you take accountability for your work. You thrive in a team environment where you are open to learning from others, adjust to others’ styles, and drive hard to reach shared objectives. You have the ability to manage requirements elicitation activities with a variety of stakeholders and manage a workload that involves tasks from concurrently running initiatives.
  
  

You have a post\-secondary diploma in IT with a concentration in networking or technology. You have a CompTIA A\+ Certification as well as Windows and/or Azure Fundamentals and MS\-900 MS365 Fundamentals. You have experience with Microsoft Server, Exchange Server and Azure Active Directory as well as DNS and DHCP servers, Firewalls and Proxy Servers (UTM). You have experience with Virtualization (Hyper\-V, VMWare) and the Microsoft Office products including MS 365 E5 and Visio. You also have experience with enterprise\-grade hardware and networking devices as well as experience with WAPs, switches and routers in wireless, copper and fiber environments. In addition, you have experience with mobile device management (MDM) and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI).
  
  

Reporting to the Support Technician Lead, you will install, maintain, test and repair systems. You will triage inbound service desk tickets and work to resolve routine technical problems with software and/or hardware or escalate to the appropriate subject matter expert.
  
  

**Specifically, you will focus on:**  

Technical Support
  
* Install, configure and maintain hardware and software for enterprise laptops, PC’s, tablets and mobile devices.
* Take ownership of, and respond to, support tickets in accordance with SLA guidelines.
* Record, track, and document the service desk request problem solving process including actions taken through to the final resolution.
* Provide onsite and remote support to end users.
* Actively participate and take ownership of New User Orientation activities, such as configuring and deploying equipment and providing quality one\-on\-one assistance during the onboarding process.
* Deploy and support mobile devices and the respective mobile device management systems.
* Maintain asset tracking for hardware and software licensing agreements.
* Maintain hardware lifecycle replacement schedules.
* Provide end users with consistent quality customer service for computer hardware, software, telephones, and smartphone platforms.
* Provide directions for end users in all IT systems in accordance with best practices within company policies and procedures.
* Document standard operating procedures and usage instructions for common IT processes and application functions.
* Understand, support and maintain Azure Active Directory and Group Policy and have an understanding of Security Groups and permissions


Network Support
  
* Assists all Support Technicians \& System and Network administrators to support and maintain the network infrastructure.
* Assists with the management and maintenance of the Active Directory infrastructure (including Azure Active Directory), UPSes, printers and M365 tenant administration to provide a seamless and secure user environment.
* Assists with the maintenance of security standards and procedures through compliance with TMG policies.
* Active engagement and ongoing support for department projects, ensuring project documentation and communication is accurate and up to date.


Administration
  
* Assist with determining the ongoing support required for completed tasks and projects in conjunction with stakeholders.
* Ensure all documentation is complete and up to date by capturing knowledge solutions for internal use and customer self\-service training.
* Support all other team members with upgrades, deployments and other activities.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

* Developing and maintaining system/shell scripts to automate routine tasks
* Installing and configuring workstations and physical and virtual server environments

* Completion of a degree or diploma program in computer science or a related discipline plus sound related experience, or an equivalent combination of training and experience

* Experience with end\-point deployments like desktop computers, laptops, cellphones, tablets, etc

* Microsoft PowerShell and other scripting languages with emphasis in automation
* Experience with ticketing systems and cloud applications \[e.g. Service Now, Microsoft Intune, Jira, MDM
